conventions.windows: All rates computed per review cycle unless refresh says otherwise.
conventions.not_observed: Always excluded from every mean, count, and σ.
conventions.immutability: Indicators read submitted (immutable) responses only; drafts never count.
conventions.trend_rule: Cross-cycle comparison only on same competency + same template version; else break the series.

events_required: assignment.created { assignment_id, cycle_id, subject_id, reviewer_id, relationship, due_at }
assignment.submitted { assignment_id, ts, device, answers[{question_id, competency_id, rating|not_observed, comment}] }

indicators.name: Reviewer completion rate
indicators.formula: count(assignment.submitted before cycle.review_end) / count(assignment.created, excl. replaced)
indicators.alert: warn breach -> hr_admin digest + one-click nudge (rate-limited 1/day/user)

indicators.name: Median time per evaluation
indicators.formula: median(submitted.ts - started.ts) over submitted assignments; cap outliers at p95 before median if resume-gaps > 30min are subtracted
indicators.alert: warn -> flag form length; correlate with A5 to find the bloated competency screens

indicators.name: Mobile share of submissions
indicators.formula: count(submitted where device='mobile') / count(submitted)

indicators.name: Decline rate
indicators.formula: count(assignment.declined) / count(assignment.created)
indicators.alert: per-subject breach -> hr_admin with replacement suggestions; subject sees only 'reviewer replaced'

indicators.name: Overdue assignments
indicators.formula: count(now > due_at and not submitted/declined)
indicators.alert: T+1d email, then every 3d, max 3; manager digest

indicators.name: Reviewer load
indicators.formula: count(active assignments) per reviewer_id at nomination close

indicators.name: Participants with < 3 eligible peers
indicators.formula: count(participants where eligible_peer_pool < 3) from dry-run validation
indicators.alert: blocks cycle transition draft -> nomination until resolved or waived

indicators.name: Comments with a specific example
indicators.formula: count(comments classified example=true) / count(non-empty comments); classifier = length >= 40 chars AND contains concrete-event heuristic (past-tense verb + object) or AI label
indicators.alert: informational; drives the one-time mobile nudge (never blocking)

indicators.name: Not-observed rate per question
indicators.formula: count(answers not_observed) / count(answers) per question_id
indicators.alert: breach -> question flagged 'unobservable as written' for next template version

indicators.name: Single-rater outlier
indicators.formula: |rating - mean(category ratings, excl. self)| > 2 * stdev(category ratings); only when category n >= 3
indicators.alert: shown to manager as context; never identifies the rater; never shown to subject

indicators.name: Leniency / severity index
indicators.formula: mean(ratings GIVEN by dept members) - mean(all ratings given org-wide), per department; never per individual reviewer
indicators.alert: |LI| >= 0.5 -> calibration-hygiene note to hr_admin; informs manager summaries

indicators.name: Score distribution drift
indicators.formula: mean(cycle scores) - mean(prior cycle scores) per competency, same template version only; report with % of categories shifting > 0.3
indicators.alert: informational; large drift + template change = broken series, render as such

indicators.name: Anonymity threshold enforcement
indicators.formula: count(report categories rendered with n < 3) — must be 0; server-side gate, not a dashboard stat
indicators.alert: any violation -> block render, page engineering; this is a correctness bug, not a metric miss

indicators.name: Category score
indicators.formula: mean(ratings in relationship category, excl. not_observed); render only when n >= 3 (manager & self exempt, n=1 attributed)

indicators.name: Others composite
indicators.formula: mean(category means), NOT pooled responses — equal weight per relationship so a large peer group can't drown direct reports

indicators.name: Self–others gap
indicators.formula: self_score - others_composite, per competency
indicators.alert: largest negative gap seeds the development plan suggestion

indicators.name: Johari quadrant classification
indicators.formula: split at 3.5/3.5 on (self, others): both high = confirmed strength; self high/others low = blind spot; self low/others high = hidden strength; both low = agreed growth

indicators.name: Cycle-over-cycle trend
indicators.formula: category_score(cycle) - category_score(prior cycle); only same competency + template version, else series break shown explicitly

indicators.name: Debrief within 14 days
indicators.formula: count(debrief.held <= released_at + 14d) / count(report.released)
indicators.alert: report released 10d without debrief scheduled -> manager nudge

indicators.name: Report acknowledgment rate
indicators.formula: count(report.acknowledged <= released_at + 7d) / count(report.released)

indicators.name: Development plan activation
indicators.formula: count(participants with devplan.created and >= 1 goal, <= released_at + 30d) / count(report.released)
indicators.alert: day 21 without plan -> manager + employee nudge

indicators.name: Check-in completion
indicators.formula: count(devplan.checkin_completed within 7d of scheduled date) / count(check-ins scheduled)
indicators.alert: missed check-in -> reschedule prompt to both parties
